tool.title: List branches (GitLab)
tool.description: List the branch names of the current checkout's GitLab project, as the forge reports them.

outputs.name: branches
outputs.description: The branches as the API returns them, one JSON object each.

selection.when: The change proposals live on GitLab — the checkout's remote is a GitLab project.
selection.limits: GitLab only. For a GitHub repository use `github-branches`.
selection.cost: `glab`, authenticated (`glab auth login` or `GITLAB_TOKEN`), and one API round trip per call.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitLab API another way. A self-managed GitLab answers on its own host, which this record cannot name; `glab` reaches it once `glab auth login --hostname` has been run for that host.

$comment.comment:
`:id` is glab's own placeholder for the current checkout's project. No
Tool input reaches it.
